subject.title: feat(ui): five-zone sidebar — agent identity card, threads/groups/coding, footer bar

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the new five-zone sidebar hierarchy, including Coding collapsed by default for users without a stored collapse preference?
rationale: The patch is a deliberate product-information-architecture change rather than a repair to an established behavior contract; only an owner can decide whether this becomes the default sidebar model.

options.title: Approve the hierarchy after final gates
options.body: Adopt the agent-first five-zone design and require final exact-head UI and upgrade-state validation before merge.

options.title: Keep the existing sidebar model
options.body: Close or supersede the redesign if the current channel-oriented session hierarchy remains the intended product direction.

options.title: Narrow the rollout
options.body: Retain only the agent-card or session-grouping pieces if owners want to defer the broader default-layout change.

recommendation.title: Approve the hierarchy after final gates
recommendation.body: Adopt the agent-first five-zone design and require final exact-head UI and upgrade-state validation before merge.
